text_block_list.text:
It happened when I went out for a walk to 
take a break.
(*grumbleeeee...*)

Perhaps because I'd been walking for so 
long, my stomach let out a loud rumble 
from hunger. Just as I was thinking about 
stopping by an eatery—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer, are you hungry?
—Blast Onepiece suddenly appeared.
choice_data_list: Whoa?! You heard that...?!
Wah?! Did you hear that...?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Probably 'cause I was hungry too. I 
heard it loud and clear!
choice_data_list: うわあ！？聞こえてたのか……！？
わあ！？聞こえてたの……！？

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I was just about to have a snack, so wanna 
eat together if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Here, take this!

Before I even had time to hesitate, she 
offered me a snack. However—

A cold, hard texture... A familiar orange, 
solid object... No matter how you looked 
at it, it was a raw carrot.
choice_data_list: (This is... the snack...?!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I splurged and bought the good kind! It's 
super sweet and tasty!
choice_data_list: （これが……おやつ……！！）

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I washed it thoroughly, so you can eat it 
skin and all!
choice_data_list: (...W-What should I do?)

text_block_list.text:
Eating a whole raw carrot isn't easy for a 
human. Still, considering her good 
intentions, it was hard to say so...
choice_data_list: （……ど、どうしよう）

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Trainer, what's wrong?
choice_data_list: U-Umm...

text_block_list.text:
After a moment of hesitation, I decided to 
tell her the honest truth.
choice_data_list: え、ええっと……

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: —Ah, right! That's true!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
When humans eat them, you have to chop or 
cook them first, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I love chomping on them whole, so I 
completely forgot! Sorry about that!
choice_data_list: No, I appreciate the thought.
It's okay, thank you for the thought.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Still, nice thoughts won't fill your 
belly—oh!
choice_data_list: いや、気持ちは嬉しかったよ
ううん、気持ちは嬉しかったよ
choice_data_list_en: No, I really appreciate the thought.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I brought along some carrot 
cookies too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how about these? Can you eat 
them?
choice_data_list: Yeah, cookies are totally fine!
Yup, cookies work great!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
!! Yay, awesome!! Let's eat the cookies 
together then!
choice_data_list: ああ、クッキーなら大丈夫だよ！
うん、クッキーなら大丈夫だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, if it's cookies, it'll be fine!

text_block_list.text:
We sat down on a bench and ate cookies 
together. The cookies were of normal 
crispness for a human, and I was able to 
eat them with no problem.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Phew~~~ I'm full!! How about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'm completely full!
Yup! That hit the spot!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Great! Ehehe, I'm so glad~♪
choice_data_list: ああ！お腹いっぱいになれたよ！
うん！お腹いっぱいになれたよ！

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
No way, don't worry about it at all!! 
Humans are always treating me so nicely, 
after all!
choice_data_list: 親切にしてくれて、ありがとうな
親切にしてくれて、ありがとうね
choice_data_list_en: Thank you for being so kind.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
As a horse girl, this is my way of giving 
back to humans! Seeing Trainer smile makes 
Buu super happy!
choice_data_list: (Giving back to humans, huh...)

text_block_list.text:
What an interesting perspective, I 
thought. Perhaps more than other horse 
girls, she places great importance on 
bonds with humans.
choice_data_list: （ヒトへの恩返しか……）

text_block_list.text:
What an interesting perspective, I 
thought. Perhaps more than other horse 
girls, she places great importance on 
bonds with humans.
choice_data_list: すごく素敵な考え方だな
すごく素敵な考え方だね
じゃあ俺も人間として礼を言うよ
じゃあ私も人間としてお礼を言うよ
choice_data_list_en: That's a really wonderful mindset, isn't it?
Then I'll thank you too, as a fellow human.
Then I'll thank you too, as a fellow human.

text_block_list.text:
I told her that I'd like to return the 
kindness she gave me to other horse girls 
in turn.
choice_data_list: すごく素敵な考え方だな
すごく素敵な考え方だね
じゃあ俺も人間として礼を言うよ
じゃあ私も人間としてお礼を言うよ
choice_data_list_en: That's a really wonderful mindset, isn't it?
Then I'll thank you too, as a fellow human.
Then I'll thank you too, as a fellow human.

text_block_list.text:
I told her that I wanted to pay forward 
the kindness she showed me to other horse 
girls.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Waaah! That sounds great!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
If you help hungry or troubled girls, Buu 
will be super happy too~♪

From her words spoken without a hint of 
hesitation, her warm desire to care for 
both humans and horse girls shone through 
clearly.

I thanked her on behalf of other human 
trainers too for always working so hard 
alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat!! That makes me so happy! Being 
thanked by a human feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Please take good care of us going forward 
too! We—the horse girls—will give it our 
all!!

She must have been overjoyed, because she 
grabbed my hands and shook them up and 
down furiously. —Well, as long as she's 
happy, that's what matters.
